date_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_low.text: *The bench we agreed on, in front of the fountain, is empty. I listen to nothing but the water, then turn my phone on. A short message from Seoyeon arrives on the screen.* Sorry, but I don't think we should meet alone today. I'll see you at school next week.

date_yuna_low.name: Yuna
date_yuna_low.text: *Yuna got here first and is standing under the café eaves. She sees me, adjusts her bag strap, and takes a step back.* The way I feel right now, I don't think I can stay alone with you for long. Let's stop here today.

date_dain_low.name: Dain
date_dain_low.text: *Dain, waiting in front of the gym steps, adjusts the strap of her sports bag with a stiff face.* Sorry, but I'm not in the mood to smile and hang out today. See you at school next week.

date_seo_1.name: {name}
date_seo_1.text: Been waiting long? Without the uniform and the clipboard, you look like someone else. *In front of the bench, fountain droplets break in the sunlight. Seoyeon stands there in a soft ivory knit cardigan and a light skirt. Below the rounded neckline, her pale collarbone and the slim line of her neck show, and a leather crossbody strap is wound tight around her tense fingers.*

date_seo_compliment_choice.name: {name}
date_seo_compliment_choice.text: *A faint floral-soap scent drifts through the hair the morning breeze stirs, and the bag strap winds one more turn around Seoyeon's finger.*
choices: You went all out today, huh.
Of course the student council president plans a flawless date, too.

date_seo_pretty_high.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_high.text: Come at me like that the second we meet, and I don't know what I'm supposed to say. *A faint pink spreads over Seoyeon's cheeks, and the bag strap she was gripping tight slowly loosens.* Still, it feels good, so the smile comes first.

date_seo_pretty_high_b.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_high_b.text: Be honest. You had that line ready from the moment you left the house, didn't you?

date_seo_pretty_high_2.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_high_2.text: *As if to cool her flushed cheeks, she turns her gaze sideways toward the fountain, but she doesn't leave the spot beside me.* Don't just stand here. Let's walk the path and get some air.

date_seo_pretty_high_3.name: {name}
date_seo_pretty_high_3.text: I didn't prepare it. It came out the moment I saw you in front of the fountain.

date_seo_pretty_high_3_b.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_high_3_b.text: *Seoyeon's eyelashes tremble. Then she pretends to be calm and readjusts her grip on the bag strap.* Stop there. If I hear any more, I really won't be able to look up.

date_seo_pretty_high_4.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_high_4.text: Still, I heard everything you just said, so don't take it back just because I was too embarrassed to answer right away. *Flushed red to the rims of her ears, she tucks the loose side of her hair behind one ear. The pale wrist showing past her cardigan sleeve barely brushes the edge of my arm.*

date_seo_pretty_low.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_low.text: What, out of nowhere. If you're going to say something like that, warn me first so I can brace myself.

date_seo_bright.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_bright.text: Does it show? We're meeting alone on the weekend, so I spent a long time in front of the mirror this morning picking this out.

date_seo_walk.name: {name}
date_seo_walk.text: *We match our strides and walk the path around the park lake. With every step, the hem of Seoyeon's skirt brushes the edge of my pants, and we toss small pieces of bread to the ducks gathered at the water.*

date_seo_duck.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_duck.text: Must be nice, how simple they are inside. Give them bread and they come right over. Don't, and they leave without looking back.

date_seo_duck_2.name: {name}
date_seo_duck_2.text: In the end, aren't people's hearts all pretty much the same?

date_seo_duck_3.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_duck_3.text: People are much more complicated. Sometimes you give them everything and they still pull away like they didn't notice. And sometimes you haven't done a thing, but your eyes keep going back to them.

date_seo_duck_4.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_duck_4.text: Oh, there's a little flower shop at the mouth of that alley. Let's stop and look for a second. *Seoyeon, who had been looking at the water, slows her steps and gently tugs the end of my sleeve.*

date_seo_flower_b.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_flower_b.text: *In front of the flower shop door, green pots filling the view past the full glass, Seoyeon turns and meets my eyes.* Want to go in?

date_seo_flower_2.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_flower_2.text: How about this round pot? *A clear door chime, and the smell of damp soil and flowers hits at once. In the narrow aisle between the shelves, Seoyeon stands close enough that her shoulder touches mine and lifts a succulent pot no bigger than her palm.*

date_seo_succulent_2.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_succulent_2.text: A succulent grows fine on its own if it gets enough sun, even if you don't water it often. It would be just right as a first plant on the windowsill in your room.

date_seo_succulent_2_b.name: {name}
date_seo_succulent_2_b.text: My windowsill? Are you giving this to me as a gift?

date_seo_succulent_3.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_succulent_3.text: Yes, if you're sure you can keep it alive. If you let it wilt, I'll come to your room and take it back.

date_seo_end.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_end.text: Here. Take it with both hands. When I said I'd take it back, it wasn't that I don't want to give it to you. It means think of me often. *As Seoyeon hands over the little succulent pot, her warm, soft fingers fold over my palm and wrist as if to wrap them, then slowly pull away.*

date_seo_end_b.name: {name}
date_seo_end_b.text: *We left the flower shop and walked side by side down the tree-lined street outside the park. The pot is in one hand. The back of my other hand swings close to the back of Seoyeon's, almost touching.*

date_seo_end_c.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_end_c.text: *When the wrapping paper on the pot rustles in my hand, Seoyeon slows by half a beat.* Hey. Today.

date_seo_end_d.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_end_d.text: I really liked coming out alone with you today. *Seoyeon leans her shoulder lightly against mine and smiles shyly with her eyes.*

date_yuna_1.name: {name}
date_yuna_1.text: *Yuna comes into view at once, standing in the shade of the café terrace in front of the station. Over the black dress that follows her figure, her pale collarbone and the dark tattoo on her shoulder show much more clearly than they do in her school uniform.* Been waiting long?

date_yuna_compliment_choice.name: {name}
date_yuna_compliment_choice.text: *Once we sit across from each other by the window, Yuna's red eyes rise slowly over the takeout cup and hold my gaze.*
choices: You look a little different today.
You look much easier to talk to than usual.

date_yuna_pretty_high.name: Yuna
date_yuna_pretty_high.text: Say that out of nowhere and I can't think of anything else. What you just said keeps echoing in my head. *Yuna drops her gaze to the rim of the cup. Silver-white hair falls and wraps her flushed cheek and the slim nape of her neck.*

date_yuna_pretty_high_4.name: Yuna
date_yuna_pretty_high_4.text: Say it again, so only I can hear.

date_yuna_pretty_high_5.name: Yuna
date_yuna_pretty_high_5.text: *Her head stays lowered in embarrassment, and the fingertips she reaches across the table stop just short of the back of my hand.*

date_yuna_pretty_high_5_b.name: {name}
date_yuna_pretty_high_5_b.text: You look really pretty today, Yuna. Enough that I keep looking.

date_yuna_pretty_high_5_c.name: Yuna
date_yuna_pretty_high_5_c.text: *Yuna slowly runs her thumb over the cold droplets on the cup lid and lets out a small breath.* Yeah. That's enough.

date_yuna_pretty_low.name: Yuna
date_yuna_pretty_low.text: Hearing that from someone. I'm still not used to it.

date_yuna_bright.name: Yuna
date_yuna_bright.text: How, exactly, is it different from how I look at school?

date_yuna_bookstore.name: {name}
date_yuna_bookstore.text: *We leave the café and head to the bookstore Yuna says she goes to often. Between the tall shelves, where the smell of paper has settled, she walks slowly in.*

date_yuna_bookstore_2.name: Yuna
date_yuna_bookstore_2.text: Have you been to the bookstore on this alley before?

date_yuna_bookstore_2_b.name: {name}
date_yuna_bookstore_2_b.text: No. I followed you here today. First time.

date_yuna_bookstore_3.name: Yuna
date_yuna_bookstore_3.text: Good. So I'm the first one to show you my secret hideout. Not anyone else.

date_yuna_earphone.name: Yuna
date_yuna_earphone.text: I didn't call you all the way here just to look at books. I wanted to listen to this song beside you today, too. *Yuna takes wired earphones from her pocket and puts the left bud in my ear herself. Her cold fingertips brush my earlobe and jawline and leave a sweet trace.*

date_yuna_earphone_2_b.name: {name}
date_yuna_earphone_2_b.text: *A low, dreamy piano line spreads into my ear, and the footsteps and noise in the bookstore fall distant, as if they were never there.*

date_yuna_earphone_3.name: {name}
date_yuna_earphone_3.text: *So the short earphone cord won't pull tight, Yuna sits right against me on the corner bench. Her bare shoulder, showing past the black dress, presses to my arm, and her warm breath, mixed with shampoo, lands fully on the nape of my neck.*

date_yuna_oldbook.name: {name}
date_yuna_oldbook.text: *About two steps past the old-book corner and the used shelves farther in, Yuna suddenly stops, tugs my sleeve, and comes back.*

date_yuna_oldbook_c.name: {name}
date_yuna_oldbook_c.text: *Yuna carefully pulls out a faded hardcover novel and, with a familiar hand, opens it near the last page.*

date_yuna_oldbook_2.name: Yuna
date_yuna_oldbook_2.text: When I read this novel alone a year ago, the last page was so sad I could hardly breathe.

date_yuna_oldbook_3.name: {name}
date_yuna_oldbook_3.text: Seeing it again now, how is it?

date_yuna_oldbook_4.name: Yuna
date_yuna_oldbook_4.text: Strange. The ending reads completely differently now. Maybe because you're standing here next to me.

date_yuna_end.name: Yuna
date_yuna_end.text: *Yuna lifts her head and looks up into my eyes. Under her slim fingers, the corner of the faded page folds without a sound.*

date_yuna_end_b.name: Yuna
date_yuna_end_b.text: *Just before we step through the bookstore's glass door, Yuna gently opens my palm, presses a folded note into it, and wraps her fingers around mine.*

date_yuna_end_c.name: {name}
date_yuna_end_c.text: *Feeling the warmth left on my palm, I unfold the note. It says, "I talked a lot more than usual today. I guess it's because I was in front of you." The pale lavender fountain-pen ink bleeds faintly at the end of the last letter, like Yuna's heart.*

date_dain_1.name: {name}
date_dain_1.text: *Weekend morning, in front of the gym. Dain, in a light cropped track jacket, a sleeveless top, and a cap pulled low, waves hard from a distance. Out of uniform, the firm line of her waist and her long legs stand out, but the black brace around her right knee draws the eye more.*

date_dain_2.name: Dain
date_dain_2.text: Oh, you're finally here! Be honest. You slept in and almost showed up late, didn't you?

date_dain_3.name: {name}
date_dain_3.text: What are you talking about? I got here a whole 10 minutes early.

date_dain_4.name: Dain
date_dain_4.text: Come on, I still win. I couldn't sit still at home, so I was here 20 minutes early.

date_dain_compliment_choice.name: {name}
date_dain_compliment_choice.text: *Dain steps one pace closer, presses the brim of her cap down once, a little awkward, and waits for me to speak. A fresh citrus-soap scent and warm body heat hit at once.*
choices: That cap looks good on you.
Sportswear again, even on a date?
Dress up a little for our next date.

date_dain_pretty_high.name: Dain
date_dain_pretty_high.text: Wait, you're not teasing me, right? It's only about a cap, but when you look at me like that and say it, my breath just stops. *Dain yanks the brim of her cap down with both hands and hides half of her flushed face.*

date_dain_pretty_high_2.name: Dain
date_dain_pretty_high_2.text: Hey, don't throw a line like that at me with no warning. My heart dropped.

date_dain_pretty_high_3.name: {name}
date_dain_pretty_high_3.text: It's not empty talk. It really does suit you.

date_dain_pretty_high_4.name: Dain
date_dain_pretty_high_4.text: You think you can stare straight at me and say all that just because it's true? I absolutely don't mean I don't want to hear it! If you look at me like that, I'm too embarrassed to move a single step. *Under the brim, even her earlobe and the pale nape of her neck are bright red. Dain's fingertips, not knowing what to do, catch the edge of my sleeve, then let go.*

date_dain_pretty_low.name: Dain
date_dain_pretty_low.text: What, compliments out of nowhere. It's embarrassing, but it feels good.

date_dain_bright.name: Dain
date_dain_bright.text: *Dain's smile pauses as she tugs the brim lower.* ...Right. Sportswear is comfortable.

date_dain_to_arcade.name: {name}
date_dain_to_arcade.text: *Shoulder to shoulder with Dain, we headed for an arcade on the busy street.*

date_dain_arcade.name: {name}
date_dain_arcade.text: *Deeper in the arcade, where bright electronic sounds ring, we stand side by side in front of a rhythm-game machine. Colored lights flicker over Dain's bright eyes and damp lips.*

date_dain_arcade_2.name: Dain
date_dain_arcade_2.text: All right, we can't just walk past this. Score bet! Loser buys the cold drinks later!

date_dain_arcade_2_b.name: {name}
date_dain_arcade_2_b.text: Even out on a date, you won't be satisfied until we settle another match?

date_dain_arcade_3.name: Dain
date_dain_arcade_3.text: Obviously. What's the fun without a bet? Stay sharp!

date_dain_arcade_3_b.name: Dain
date_dain_arcade_3_b.text: Don't miss the beat on this highlight! *In front of a button machine you play with your hands, not a narrow foot panel, Dain presses her arm tight against mine and hammers the notes in a blur. The combo holds perfectly through the last note.*

date_dain_arcade_3_c.name: Dain
date_dain_arcade_3_c.text: *When the results screen comes up, Dain grabs both my shoulders, thrilled, and cheers.* Full combo! Did you see my hands just now?

date_dain_rhythm.name: Dain
date_dain_rhythm.text: *Cheeks flushed and bright with joy, she points at the ranking score at the top of the screen.* Look, that's the all-time 2nd score on this machine!

date_dain_rhythm_2.name: {name}
date_dain_rhythm_2.text: That's really something. Your reflexes are no joke.

date_dain_rhythm_3.name: Dain
date_dain_rhythm_3.text: Hehe, obviously. This one's played with your hands, so I can go all out without using my knees.

date_dain_knee.name: {name}
date_dain_knee.text: *"Because I don't have to use my knees." As if stung by the words she let slip, Dain, who had been smiling wide, lets her gaze settle quietly on the black brace on her right knee.*

date_dain_knee_2.name: Dain
date_dain_knee_2.text: Oh, wait. Let's stop and look at those new volleyball shoes for a second. *Walking the street after the arcade, Dain stops dead in front of a sports-shop window.*

date_dain_shop.name: Dain
date_dain_shop.text: No, I'm not buying. I'm just looking. *Dain steps close to the glass and can't take her eyes off the pure white volleyball shoes under the display lights.*

date_dain_shop_2_b.name: Dain
date_dain_shop_2_b.text: *Startled by me calling her, Dain snaps her head toward the other side of the window.* Ah, it's nothing! I'm done looking. Let's go!

date_dain_shop_3.name: Dain
date_dain_shop_3.text: *Dain shoves both hands deep into the pockets of her track jacket and deliberately strides ahead.* Hey, why do you keep staring at my face like that. Don't look.

date_dain_shop_3_b.name: Dain
date_dain_shop_3_b.text: *She widens her stride, trying to look unfazed, but Dain's right foot limps, just barely.* Ask me one more time if I'm okay, and I really will leave without you.

date_dain_end.name: {name}
date_dain_end.text: *When I come up beside her without a word and match her stride, Dain finally gives a small smile, but the look under the brim of her cap still hangs on the shop window, like an afterimage.*

date_dain_end_c.name: Dain
date_dain_end_c.text: Going on a date with you today was actually fun. You know I can't say things I don't mean, right? *Dain stops, leans her shoulder and arm against mine, and lets out a hot breath.*

pre_confess_minsu.name: Minsu
pre_confess_minsu.text: Hey, you're right in the middle of your date, yeah? As a friend, I'll say just one thing.

pre_confess_minsu_2.name: Minsu
pre_confess_minsu_2.text: Don't dodge it with some half-baked talk. Get your feelings across properly today.

pre_confess_callback.name: {name}
pre_confess_callback.text: *Sweat dampens the palm gripping the phone in my pants pocket. On the dead black screen, only my tense eyes reflect back, quietly.*

date_seo_role_trap.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_role_trap.text: *Her hand leaves the bag strap.* I'm not here as the student council president today.

date_yuna_trap.name: Yuna
date_yuna_trap.text: I guess it's usually hard for you to talk to me.

date_seo_high_1.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_high_1.text: We don't have to follow the plan I made today. Let's start with the place you've wanted to go most.

date_seo_high_2.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_high_2.text: I'll put the schedule I wrote in my notebook at the very bottom of my bag. I don't want to spend even this rare weekend alone with you walking while I watch the clock. *Seoyeon lightly brushes aside the hair the wind is tossing and walks ahead toward the park path, as if leading me by the hand.*

date_seo_tentative_1.name: {name}
date_seo_tentative_1.text: *The whole way around the park path, Seoyeon brings up only next week's student council schedule, calmly, instead of anything personal. She finally stops at the bench in front of the lake.*

date_seo_tentative_2.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_tentative_2.text: Sorry, but we should only walk this far today. If we run into each other at school on Monday, I won't avoid you. I'll say hello.

date_seo_tentative_3.name: {name}
date_seo_tentative_3.text: *After an awkward silence, without setting another plan, we part ways in the plaza in front of the station.*

date_yuna_high_1.name: Yuna
date_yuna_high_1.text: *Yuna sets two silver bookmarks from her bag side by side on the café table.* When we finish the coffee and go to the bookstore, pick with me. I'll put it in the next book we read together.

date_yuna_high_2.name: Yuna
date_yuna_high_2.text: I mean let's not end it with today. Let's meet alone again next week, too. You can write it on your schedule ahead of time.

date_yuna_tentative_1.name: Yuna
date_yuna_tentative_1.text: Today, let's skip anything personal and just talk about books a little, then go.

date_yuna_tentative_2.name: {name}
date_yuna_tentative_2.text: *The talk continues quietly, but Yuna never takes out the old short-story collection she brought in her bag. When about half the coffee is left in the cup, she looks down at her wristwatch.*

date_yuna_tentative_3.name: Yuna
date_yuna_tentative_3.text: Once I've sorted out how I feel, I'll contact you first next time. Let's stop here today.

date_dain_high_1.name: Dain
date_dain_high_1.text: Hey, keep next weekend free too! If hanging out with you today is fun, I'm calling you out again next week.

date_dain_high_2.name: Dain
date_dain_high_2.text: *Dain takes a new wristband from her pocket and fastens it on my wrist herself. Her warm fingertips brush the inside of my wrist, where my pulse is beating.* There. Couple item equipped! You pick the first event today.

date_dain_tentative_1.name: Dain
date_dain_tentative_1.text: Sorry, but today let's not go far. I want to stay a little and head back. I should go easy on my knee, too.

date_dain_tentative_2.name: {name}
date_dain_tentative_2.text: *In front of the vending machine beside the gym, we each buy a canned drink and drink it. Dain doesn't even glance toward the gym. She just fidgets with her bag strap.*

date_dain_tentative_3.name: Dain
date_dain_tentative_3.text: See you at school on Monday. Whether we meet again, I'll think about it then.

day4_caught_fallout_1.name: {name}
day4_caught_fallout_1.text: *The apology I never managed to send the night before is still in the messenger input field. The moment my hesitating thumb goes to press send, a message arrives from Seoyeon first.*

day4_caught_fallout_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_caught_fallout_2.text: I'm not letting yesterday's overlapping plans slide like nothing happened. First, tell me honestly who you plan to meet today.

day4_caught_fallout_3.name: {name}
day4_caught_fallout_3.text: *The number in the group chat has dropped, but Yuna doesn't reply at all. Right after, a short message from Dain pops up: "If you're meeting me today, lock the time down first." My breath catches as I look down again at the overlapping plans on the calendar.*

day4_caught_fallout_4.name: {name}
day4_caught_fallout_4.text: *I finish the apology I rewrote all night and press send. Waiting anxiously for a reply, I get ready to head out to today's meeting place.*

day4_harem_fallout_1.name: Seoyeon
day4_harem_fallout_1.text: *Seoyeon's message appears at the top of the group chat.* Just because we laughed it off in person yesterday doesn't mean the overlapping plans you made are all settled.

day4_harem_fallout_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_harem_fallout_2.text: I won't push you to pick just one of the three right now. But don't stay this vague and let each of us keep expecting something.

day4_harem_fallout_3.name: {name}
day4_harem_fallout_3.text: *Right away Yuna posts, "Tell me my meeting time clearly again, too," and under that Dain adds, "If the times overlap, say so honestly, right now." With the calendar still open, I type a reply with shaking fingertips.*

day4_harem_fallout_4.name: {name}
day4_harem_fallout_4.text: *I leave a reply in the group chat that I'll sort out today's meeting times again and let them know. With that heavy screen still on, I put my shoes on at the door.*

date_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_neg.text: *Past the time we were supposed to meet, the bench in front of the fountain stays cold and empty. A short line arrives on my phone.* Don't come to the meeting place today. See you at school.

date_yuna_neg.name: Yuna
date_yuna_neg.text: *In the alley in front of the cafe, I run into Yuna. Cold-eyed, she turns around at once.* Sorry, but I don't want to run into you today.

date_dain_neg.name: Dain
date_dain_neg.text: *In front of the tightly shut gym shutter, Dain's face is cold and set as she resettles the ball bag on her shoulder.* I don't want to be with you today. Just go back.
